s1.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with respiratory and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Painful ecchymotic lesions with hemorrhagic bullae
Multifocal alveolar infiltrates on chest radiography and CT
Thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy on skin biopsy
key_facts: Intermittent night sweats for several months
Arthralgias of the wrists and ankles
Multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute febrile illness with respiratory and cutaneous manifestations
salient_findings: Painful ecchymotic lesions with hemorrhagic bullae
Multifocal alveolar infiltrates on chest radiography and CT
Thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy on skin biopsy
key_facts: Intermittent night sweats for several months
Arthralgias of the wrists and ankles
Multiple painful ecchymoses with hemorrhagic bullae
Elevated lactate dehydrogenase and erythrocyte sedimentation rate
Positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus

shortlist.label: Infectious vasculitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has fever, shaking chills, and skin lesions with hemorrhagic bullae, consistent with vasculitis secondary to infection

shortlist.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has purpura, arthralgias, and abdominal pain, which are classic symptoms of Henoch-Schönlein purpura

shortlist.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has renal involvement, as suggested by elevated lactate dehydrogenase and erythrocyte sedimentation rate, and skin lesions consistent with vasculitis

shortlist.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has respiratory symptoms, such as bilateral wheezes, and skin lesions, which could be consistent with Wegener's granulomatosis

shortlist.label: Churg-Strauss syndrome
shortlist.why_kept: Patient has asthma-like symptoms, such as bilateral wheezes, and eosinophilia is not explicitly ruled out, making Churg-Strauss syndrome a possible diagnosis

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms, including fever, shaking chills, and recent respiratory illness in a family member, along with the presence of a recent respiratory illness in the 3-year-old son and positive FilmArray respiratory panel for respiratory syncytial virus, suggest an infectious cause. The skin biopsy showing thrombotic paucicellular vasculopathy and the lack of significant neutrophils or leukocytoclasia also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Henoch-Schönlein purpura
rejected.why: Typically presents with abdominal pain, gastrointestinal bleeding, and renal involvement, which are not prominent in this case

rejected.label: Microscopic polyangiitis
rejected.why: Usually presents with renal involvement and pulmonary hemorrhage, which are not seen in this patient

rejected.label: Wegener's granulomatosis
rejected.why: Characterized by granulomatous inflammation and necrotizing vasculitis, which are not present in the skin biopsy

rejected.label: Churg-Strauss syndrome
rejected.why: Typically presents with asthma, eosinophilia, and vasculitis, which are not prominent in this case
